text.value: Each time this blade fells an enemy, gold seems to flow in its wake.
The strikes of this blade carry twice the lethal force of an ordinary weapon.
This sword imbues its wielder with enhanced vitality and life force.
With each foe it fells, this sword restores the health of its wielder.
This ancient blade, though worn by time, retains its keen edge

Unlocks at Max Athletic.
Boosts total health by 2.

Unlocks at max creative.
Your Attack deals more damage.

Unlocks at max smart.
Sometimes spawns damage boosts during combat.
